newsitem.title: RUSSIA: VOLLEYBALL-ITALY BEAT CUBA TO WIN WORLD LEAGUE FINAL.
newsitem.headline: VOLLEYBALL-ITALY BEAT CUBA TO WIN WORLD LEAGUE FINAL.

text.p: Two-times men's volleyball world champions Italy beat Cuba in straight sets on Saturday to win the eighth World League finals in Moscow.
Led by Michele Pasinato and Claudio Bonati, Italy clinched their sixth league title with a 15-8 15-5 15-10 victory in under two hours to take the $1 million first prize.
"We saved our best game for the final," Pasinato said. "We played especially well on the attack and our block proved too strong for the opposition."
It was Italy's second straight win against the Cubans in two days. They defeated them three sets to one in a group match to earn a place in the final.
Russia, urged on by some 8,000 home fans, earlier upset reigning Olympic champions the Netherlands 15-8 15-12 15-8 in the bronze medal match.
